_comment: Mutation testing via the Vitest runner: per-test coverage means only the tests covering a mutant rerun, so mutating the whole app stays fast in CI.
_thresholds_note: No break here on purpose. `break` is one number for the whole app, and the app is not one number: measured per shard the score runs from the low single digits to about 70%, so any value that passed the best shard would wave the worst ones through, and 100 -- which this said for a long time, and which the app has never met -- failed every shard on every run until the failure meant nothing. Enforcement is per shard instead: each entry in the matrix of .github/workflows/mutation.yml carries a `floor` it may not drop below, seeded from what it measured and raised by hand when someone writes tests. high/low only tint the report. Genuine equivalent mutants carry documented // Stryker disable comments (see EQUIVALENTS.md). Runs weekly via that workflow.
